svg.title: Gold Reporting Architecture
svg.desc: Gold fact tables and dimensions feeding eight reporting views consumed by Power BI / downstream reporting.
svg.text: SQL Server · Gold layer · fact and dimension sources → eight reporting views → Power BI / downstream reporting
Three independent fact aggregations, each LEFT JOINed to gold.dim_truck
AGGREGATE BY truck_key · own date filter
AGGREGATE BY truck_key · own date filter
AGGREGATE BY truck_key · own date filter

Dimensions are drawn only where joined: gold.dim_route is used by vw_revenue_performance only, gold.dim_facility by vw_delivery_performance only, gold.dim_trailer by vw_fleet_performance only. vw_fleet_performance has no route relationship.
